Folder

The Folder view displays comprehensive information about a selected folder, including its name, description, and any attachments stored within it.

Folders help organize your documents and attachments by grouping related items together. Each folder can contain multiple attachments and provides a centralized location for managing related files.

Available Actions

From this view, you can manage your folder and its contents:

• Click the Edit button to modify the folder's name and description

• View and download all attachments contained within the folder

• Add new attachments to organize related files together

• Delete the folder and all its contents when no longer needed

Related Topics

To learn how to create or edit folders, see: Folder — Edit
